records.public_safe_text: unit 1 was traveling through the apartment complex driving approximately 5 miles per hour. unit 2 was running through [roadway] between buildings without looking for vehicle traffic. unit 1 stated he saw unit 2 at the last second and was unable top in time. unit 1 struck unit 2 with the front of his vehicle. unit 2 fell to the ground, but got up and ran to her apartment. unit 1 said he followed the child to the apartment and was able to contact her mother. unit 1 gave the mother his information and instead of waiting for police, unit 2's mother decided to take her to the nearest urgent care. unit 1 stated he would meet them there. unit 1 relocated to the urgent car off the [roadway] and unit 2 or her mother were no longer there. we had already relocated to that location and were able to contact unit 1 at that time. i spoke to medical staff at the location and the advised me that spoke to the mother and unit 2 about the incident. they stated that once they heard what had happened, they told her to relocate to higher echelon of care. they said unit 2 and her mother left without telling them where they were going. the staff stated that unit 2 looked okay, but had scratches to her back. however, they advised that the injuries did not look life threatening. at this time, with no victim, we spoke with unit 1 and after gathering his information, advised him to relocate back to the incident location. once back at the incident location, i notified the supervisor of our incident and had a uedi assigned to the call to process the scene. i had a cover officer assigned to the call to check local priority 2 hospitals in our service area for unit 2. we stood by at the scene until detective guzman #2224 made the location and photographed the incident location and unit 1's vehicle. the officer looking at other hospitals stated he did not locate any mvped victims. i called several hospitals near the incident location asking if they had any patients matching the description of unit 2 with no luck. i attempted to contact management for the apartment to see if i could get a contact number for the residence of the apartment number where we believed unit 2 to live. they did not answer. tid was contacted and informed of the accident and the steps taken so far to find unit 2. i was advised to released unit 1 with a [case id] due to no criminal offense occurring. while speaking to unit 1, unit 2 and her mother returned back to the incident location. their information was gathered and the mother advised us that unit 2's injuries were minor. detective guzman came back out to the location to photograph unit 2's injuries and tid was called back and updated on the incident. once all parties had been identified, the scene had been processed, and all follow up contacts were made, both unit 1 and unit 2's mother were given a [case id] and told to call back if needed.

approached the intersection of the [roadway]. the driver of unit 2 stated that he was attempting to turn the right to go onto the [roadway]. the driver of unit 2 stated that as he attempted to turn the driver of unit 1 attempted to pass him by going [roadway] instead of the outside. the driver of unit 2 stated that he has witnesses who saw the accident f i would like to speak to them and i advised him i would after i spoke to unit 1 driver. i spoke to the driver of unit 1 who stated that she was driving south bound on the [roadway] when she was struck out of now where by unit 2. i asked the driver of unit 1 if she saw unit 2 and she stated that she was struck out of now where. i asked unit 1 driver if she needed medical attention but stated no and that she did have a prior existing heart condition and would be taken to the doctors office by her daughter who was on scene. i gathered unit 1 drivers information and the driver of unit 2's information as well. i spoke to the driver of unit 2 and asked him if he had that witness available as the driver of unit 2 stated that it was not his fault and waned me to hear it from a witness as well. i spoke to the pedestrian (witness) who stated that the driver of unit 1 was driving south bound on the 7100 block when the driver of unit 2 attempted to [roadway]. the pedestrian stated that the driver of unit 1 went on the inside to pass unit 2 but in doing so was hit by unit 2 as he was attempting to turn. i gathered the pedestrians information and advised both drivers that i would be making a crash report and their insurance companies would be the ones to decide who at fault. as i spoke to the driver of unit 1 she asked what the driver of unit 2 stated and i advised her as to what unit 2 driver stated. the driver of unit 1 stated she was hit by unit 2 being that it would be impossible for her to stop [roadway]. the driver of unit 1 also stated that the pedestrian who stated that he was a witness was not a wit ness but rather a passenger of unit 2 vehicle. i would like to note that when i spoke to the witness i advised him if he was unit 2 friend or if he had any interest in the outcome of the accident and the to a complete stop. i provided both driver with a [case id] to reference the crash and advised them that their insurance companies would be the ones to determine fault. both drivers left the location without incident. dme available.

(unit 1's written statement obtained) at the request of unit 1 driver and her mother at the scene, unit 1 was released to them.

records.public_safe_text: while on routine patrol police responded to a private property major accident at the listed time and location. upon arrival i made contact with unit 2 who had already been loaded up in the ambulance. ems informed me that unit 2 did not have any life threatening injuries, but was being transported. unit 2 stated that she was walking her dog and had her phone flash light on to help make herself known. unit 2 stated that as she began to [roadway], and she saw unit 1 stopped at the stop sign. unit 2 stated that unit 1 then proceeded from a full stop into her about 5-8 feet from her location. unit 2 stated she was pushed back by the collision, [roadway] and laid down not far off. unit 1 stated that he went to a complete stop at the stop sign and waited until vehicle traffic cleared before [roadway]. [roadway], he collided with unit 2, stating that he immediately stopped once he made contact with unit 2. he stated that he attempted to assist unit 2 but that she refused to respond or accept any assistance from him. unit 2 stated he left his car exactly where the collision happened and stood by until our arrival. all other details matched unit 2's statements. witnesses also spoke of the same narrative listed. due to the accident occurring on private property, no charges could be placed on any involved parties. both parties were given a [case id]. unit 2's dog that she had with her was given a courtesy ride back to their residence and left with unit 2's roommate. both tid and sgt lively were called for advisement during the investigation.

and 3 were stopped on was about the same width as two lanes because it was where two lanes began to merge. units 4, 5, 6 and 7 were pedestrians on the traffic stop. unit 4 was a san jacinto county sheriff deputy. unit 4 was standing near the fl of unit 2 and unit 5 was standing near the fc of unit 2. unit 6 was standing near the fc of unit 3 with unit 7 standing just in front of him.. as unit 1 approached, the driver while intoxicated, failed to slow down or move over for the stationary emergency vehicle and actually drove partially off the roadway, [roadway] [roadway]. the driver of unit 1 was found to be under the influence of alcohol. unit 1 struck the bl of unit 2 with the fr of unit 1. the offset impact caused unit 2 to go forward and rotate slightly to the right. the impact from the initial collision caused unit 2 to strike unit 3 in the bl with the fl of unit 2, and unit 2 struck units 4 and 5 pushing them into the grassy ditch on the south side of the roadway. once unit 2 struck unit 3 it caused unit 3 to go slightly forward striking unit 6 with the fd of unit 3 but did not cause any damage to the front of unit 3. unit 7 was not struck by a vehicle but was on scene and reportedly pushed by unit 6. unit 1 came to rest facing southbound in the eastbound lanes of us 190. units 2 and 3 came to rest facing eastbound off the south side of us 190. units 4, 5, 6 and 7 had all moved prior to my arrival. pending blood results from the dps crime lab for unit 1 driver. on [date], dps crime lab results showed unit 1 driver bac to be 0. 168. no drug analysis was done due to the high alcohol concentration.

records.deidentified_narrative: on [date] at approximately 19:08 hours i, deputy l. young #4536, was dispatched to a collision with injury located at the [roadway]. this call was later changed to an auto / ped collision resulting in a written report. dispatch notes advised the callers sister was hit by a car [roadway]. as i arrived on scene i observed a crowd of people standing around a female who was sitting [roadway]. the female was crying from pain and holding the back of her head. one of the men standing around her was holding some type of clothing against the back of her head and talking on the phone. the female was identified as:lowe, kelli nichole w/f dob: [date] kelli was in a lot of pain and bleeding from the back of her head. the male on the phone was identified as:lowe, luke aaron w/m dob: 02/26/1999kelli and luke are siblings that live together in a [roadway]. the other individuals from the crowd said that they did not witness the collision and they were released from the scene. according to luke, he and his sister were out taking their two dogs for a walk. the two of them were [roadway] and just about to pass in front of squeaky clean car wash. luke advised he was walking a little ahead of his sister and she was following behind him about ten or fifteen feet. as luke crossed the entry/exit for the car wash he observed a gray colored sedan leaving the parking lot and approaching the same area he was in. luke advised that he passed in front of the vehicle and made it across the entry/[roadway] safely. moments later he heard a loud thud behind him and when he turned around he saw his sister laying over the top of the gray vehicle and falling to the ground. when kelli fell to the ground the back of [roadway] causing her to lose consciousness for one to two minutes. emergency medical services had already been dispatch to the collision and once they arrived on scene they were able to stabilized [roadway]. [medical facility]. the vehicle involved in the collision remained on scene and was identified as:2015 gray hyundai equus 4dtx lp: ksv0652vin: kmhgh4jh9fu094220 the driver was later identified as:jenkins, alfred d iii b/m dob: [date] tx dl: 01939302alfred stated that as he was leaving the parking lot he looked left to check for eastbound traffic but he did not remember looking right to check for anything coming the opposite direction. as he continued pulling out of the parking lot and [roadway] he hit a female pedestrian with the front of his vehicle. alfred was not injured during the collision and his vehicle sustained minor damage. alfred completed a written statement that was submitted at the collier building. i took pictures of the vehicle and location of the accident. all photographs were submitted by email to crime lab digital photographs as evidence. i was not able to photograph kelli's injuries due to her being transported so quickly. alfred also completed and information exchange form which i gave to luke before he left the scene to be with his sister. both parties were given tcso business cards that included [case id] and i explained to them that a report would be written to document the incident. i contacted sgt. c. hughes #3354 and briefed him on the incident. i let him know that the driver involved in the collision is an associate municipal judge for the city of austin. the incident noted in this report was captured on a panasonic arbitrator camera equipped on unit 4692 and tagged under cad [identifier] which was uploaded to the crime lab. there is no body camera footage for this call. eor

records.deidentified_narrative: police responded to the above listed address for a major accident. upon arrival i observed p. e. d (pedestrian) on the left side of w martin on the ground holding his left leg. i contacted the p. e. d whom stated, that he was walking in the cross walk (north bound on flores) when he was struck by unit 1. p. e. d stated there was still ten seconds left for him to finish walking through the cross walk and that he had the right of way. ems/safd arrived and began evaluating p. e. d. i then contacted the driver of unit 1 whom stated, he was driving northbound on n flores and was turning w. b (left) on martin. unit 1 stated that there was a green light on south flores, when he turned. unit 1 stated he did not see p. e. d until it was to late and slammed on his brakes, still hitting p. e. d. unit 1 stated he did not roll over ped, and that p. e. d bounced off of his vehicle. p. e. d was transported to downtown baptist by medic 1. i contacted sgt dimmick#3163 and informed him of the details of the crash. uedi detective coington #2338 made the location and took photos of the crash. i drove to downtown baptist and spoke with p. e. d whom stated he did not go under the vehice and that he bounced off of it. during this time p. e. d. was in stable condtion and had non life threatning injuries. unit 1 was at fault for not yielding to the pedestrian crossing the crosswalk.
